body: accessapikey skips resources removed from the statements, as apikey.Vocabulary does. A passkey sign-in without user verification counts as one factor, so the twofactor default asks. OAuth and SSO sign-ins keep the default of not asking. SSO keeps only the POST start route.
title: Owner 2026-10-08: accessapikey matches built-in; non-UV passkey asks 2FA; OAuth/SSO no 2FA; SSO POST only
